vetSays.line: 👥 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Company makes the road shorter.
👥 A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan walks out with A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm. "Nobody walks alone today."
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
🚶 A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan is back with A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "dusty-green diamond leaves with white mealy underside, grows in disturbed soil is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)

🌿 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A man, maybe 40s, with a limp about Morris. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.
A man, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair sets out to find A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A person, maybe 30s about Morris. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Mario, Morris, Deborah, Sourav and Omar met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Mario, Morris, Deborah, Sourav, Omar are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
You STRIKE the Elder Dustboar for 106 (Stone knife).
The Elder Dustboar falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Dustboar!

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Morris, Deborah, Sourav and Amina met them at the door — 4 put down. Morris, Deborah, Sourav, Amina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mario just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amina just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Nostalgia!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Deborah, Sourav and Omar met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Deborah, Sourav, Omar are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Nicolás met them at the door — 1 put down. Nicolás is hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leroy just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
